pages.title: Margot Weekly — November 23, 2026
pages.summary: The S&P 500 fell 2.4% this week and is +6.7% for the year; every sector fell, with consumer discretionary holding up best (-1.0%) and energy falling most (-6.0%).

pages.title: Allot Ltd. (ALLT)
pages.summary: At $7.64, ALLT trades 35% below the $11.82 per share our base-case DCF supports; revenue grew 16% in the latest quarter from a year earlier, with a 10% net margin.

pages.title: Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN)
pages.summary: At $255.39, AMZN trades close to the $228.99 per share our base-case DCF supports (1.5x the $169.05 capex-adjusted value, which treats spending above depreciation as investment); revenue grew 12% in the latest quarter from a year earlier…

pages.title: CleanSpark, Inc. (CLSK)
pages.summary: At $5.53, CLSK has no positive DCF value: the base-case model comes to -$9.66 per share, because projected cash flows don't cover its net debt; revenue shrank 30% in the latest quarter from a year earlier, and lost money (net margin -147%).
